From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucia Ramos <lucia.ramos@wellmorehealth.com>, Tom Harper <tharper@wellmorehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-signature activation plan & owner roster — WellMore Health

Hi Lucia / Tom —

Congrats again on getting the agreement across the finish line. As discussed on the call, we want to kick off activation next week and make sure roles/expectations are clear so your teams can start routing requests into Redwood with minimal friction. I put an initial checklist attached (WellMore_Activation_Checklist_v1.xlsx) — it's intentionally lightweight.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Week 1 (Jul 6): Kickoff + SSO & network prep; Redwood provides access for a staging workspace.
- Week 2: Data routing + sample prompts & model selection; basic evals.
- Week 3: Training for PMs & SREs; production cutover planning.

Owners from our side:
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success Lead (primary day-to-day owner, onboarding shepherd)
- Karthik Iyer — Implementation PM (technical runbook, infra coordination)
- Naomi Feldman — Enablement & training (SOM, training schedules, docs)

Action items for WellMore before kickoff:
1) Confirm SSO provider and SAML admin contact (we need the IdP metadata).
2) Provide representative sample prompts & redaction rules (2–3 sample workflows).
3) Approve proposed kickoff window (Jul 6–8).

Marissa will drive the kickoff scheduling and pre-kickoff checklist. Karthik, Naomi — copying you for visibility; please flag anything you'd change in owners/timeline.

Lucia/Tom — can you confirm Jul 6 for the kickoff and share the SAML contact? Also confirm who on your side will own network whitelisting (IP range or cloud peering)?

Thanks — excited to get started.

—
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks Aditya — this looks good. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Jul 6 works for the kickoff (we prefer morning PT).
- SSO: we use Okta. I'll introduce our SAML admin (Jason Lin) below.
- Network: our cloud infra team will handle whitelisting — Tom is the lead there.
- Data: we'll share two sample prompts and the redaction rules (PII policy) by EOD Thu.

Two asks from procurement/security that I want to surface before kickoff so we can avoid blockers: 
1) Minimum data retention settings for logs (we typically need retention settings documented).
2) Any SOC2 or penetration test evidence docs (our security team will request).

Looping in Jason and Tom so they can confirm details.

Best,
Lucia
Head of Integrations | WellMore Health
lucia.ramos@wellmorehealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-signature activation plan & owner roster — WellMore Health

Thanks Lucia — and great, morning PT kickoff is fine. Quick answers to the procurement/security asks: 

- Retention: our default request/response logs are 90 days by default for hosted customers; we can tighten that to 30 days for WellMore under the contract. We also provide redact-before-store options and can export audit logs on demand.
- SOC2 & pen test: attaching our SOC 2 Summary and a pointer to the full package (we provide to customers under an NDA).

I'll hand ownership of the kickoff scheduling and the technical runbook to Marissa and Karthik respectively. Naomi will coordinate the enablement calendar.

Marissa / Karthik / Naomi — next steps:
- Marissa: propose three 60-minute kickoff slots for Jul 6 (morning PT) and include a short agenda (SSO, network, sample prompts, milestone dates).
- Karthik: prepare a pre-kickoff infra checklist (expected firewall rules, VPC peering notes, any cloud roles we need access to for validations).
- Naomi: draft a one-hour training outline for PMs + SREs and a short end-user cheat sheet.

Attachments: WellMore_Security_Summary.pdf (SOC2 overview) and WellMore_SOW_v3.pdf (final SOW).

Aditya

Internal —

Thanks Aditya. Lucia confirmed morning PT on Jul 6. I'm sending three time options to the customer now (7:00am PT, 9:00am PT, 11:00am PT).

I've attached a pared-down kickoff agenda and the activation checklist I will use as the project tracker. Notes for internal owners: 
- Pre-kickoff items (owned by Karthik): request Okta metadata (Jason), collect IP ranges for whitelisting, verify service accounts and any proxy/firewall rules. Please drop the infra checklist into the shared Drive folder (link below) by EOD Fri.
- Training & enablement (Naomi): please draft the PM + SRE agenda; include a 15-min troubleshooting flow for common agent errors.
- Customer comms & escalation path: I will be the primary CS contact; Aditya will join the first meeting for commercial context.

Please confirm if we want to use Dedicated vs Hosted for initial testing. My recommendation: start on Hosted in staging to iterate quickly; if performance tuning is needed we can plan a Dedicated pilot in Q3.

Drive: https://drive.example/wellmore/onboarding (internal)
